feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 September 2026 4:36pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 05 September 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will decline as frontal systems affect the Irish Sea overnight.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing south 4 or 5 this evening, increasing 5 or 6 overnight, but remaining south 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate overnight but remaining slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain or drizzle overnight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, but south 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area at first. Veering west 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Monday, then increasing southwest 5 or 6 late Monday morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but slight in the southeast of the area. Becoming slight overnight into Monday, then moderate in the afternoon


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first, becoming fair for a time. Further rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
